narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A kilometre is a thousand metres, so one square kilometre is one thousand square metres.
<bookmark mark='strip'/>A thousand square metres fills only a thin strip, one metre wide, along one edge.
<bookmark mark='empty'/>Nearly all of the big square is still empty, so that is far too small.
